mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_verification_job SET version=#{version},status=#{status},state_json=#{stateJson},active_invoice_id=#{invoiceId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND input_json=#{inputJson} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM finance_resource WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND resource_type='INVOICE' AND id=#{invoiceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM invoice_verification_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM invoice_verification_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_invoice_id=#{invoiceId}

SELECT j.* FROM invoice_verification_job j JOIN finance_resource r ON r.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND r.resource_type='INVOICE' AND r.id=j.invoice_id WHERE j.tenant_id=#{parameters.tenant} AND j.invoice_id IN (#{item}) AND j.status='SUCCEEDED' AND j.invoice_version=r.version-1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_verification_job later WHERE later.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND later.invoice_id=j.invoice_id AND later.invoice_version=r.version)

SELECT j.* FROM invoice_verification_job j JOIN finance_resource r ON r.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND r.resource_type='INVOICE' AND r.id=j.invoice_id WHERE j.tenant_id=#{parameters.tenant} AND j.invoice_id IN (#{item}) AND j.status='SUCCEEDED' AND j.invoice_version<r.version AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_verification_job later WHERE later.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND later.invoice_id=j.invoice_id AND later.invoice_version>j.invoice_version)
SELECT tenant_id,id,trace_id FROM invoice_verification_job WHERE status='QUEUED' OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM invoice_verification_job WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND invoice_id=#{argument2} AND id<#{argument3} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{argument4}
